lessons.title: Story Time: A Story About Time
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to discuss the sequence of events in a story about a day.
success_criteria: I can say what happened first.
I can say what happened last.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss the parts of a day (morning, afternoon, evening).
lessons.main_teaching_input: Read a story following a character through a day, modelling sequencing discussion.
lessons.independent_task: Children sequence the story's events using time-of-day vocabulary.
resources_needed: Story book following a day's events

differentiation.greater_depth: Explain the sequence in full sentences

lessons.assessment_notes: Note comprehension of time sequencing — evidence for ENG.R2.
lessons.plenary: Recap the story's sequence of events.
lessons.home_link: Talk through your own day's events in order.

lessons.title: Telling Time Consolidation: O'Clock and Half Past
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to tell the time to the hour and half hour fluently.
success_criteria: I can read o'clock times confidently.
I can read half past times confidently.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap time-telling from across the year.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Consolidate reading and setting o'clock and half past times using a demonstration clock.
lessons.independent_task: Children complete a range of time-telling activities matching times to daily activities.
key_questions: What time do you have breakfast?

differentiation.greater_depth: Mix o'clock and half past confidently, plus quarter past/to if ready

lessons.assessment_notes: End-of-year consolidation check on time-telling — evidence for MATHS.MEA.
lessons.home_link: Practise telling the time on a clock at home.

lessons.title: Writing a Timetable for My Day
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to write a simple timetable of their day using time vocabulary.
success_criteria: I can write times for my day's activities.
I can use time vocabulary correctly.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss the order of a typical school day.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model writing a simple timetable listing activities and approximate times.
lessons.independent_task: Children write their own simple daily timetable using time vocabulary.
key_questions: What comes next in your day?

differentiation.greater_depth: Create a detailed timetable with several time points

lessons.assessment_notes: Note application of time vocabulary to writing — evidence for ENG.W2/MATHS.MEA links.
lessons.plenary: Share daily timetables with a partner.
lessons.home_link: Make a timetable for your weekend.

lessons.title: Measuring Length Consolidation
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to measure and compare length using standard and non-standard units.
success_criteria: I can measure using cubes.
I can measure using a ruler.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap measuring length from across the year.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Consolidate measuring length using both non-standard units (cubes) and an introduction to standard units (a ruler, cm).
lessons.independent_task: Children measure classroom objects using both cubes and a ruler, comparing results.
key_questions: How many cubes long is this?
How many centimetres long is this?

differentiation.greater_depth: Measure with a ruler and read centimetre measurements

lessons.assessment_notes: End-of-year consolidation check on length measurement, introducing standard units — evidence for MATHS.MEA.
lessons.home_link: Measure an object at home with a ruler if you have one.

lessons.title: Phonics: Reading Time Words
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to blend and read time-themed words.
success_criteria: I can blend and read time words.
I can read a sentence about time.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Introduce/reinforce a grapheme, blending time-themed words (e.g. 'clock', 'time', 'day').
lessons.independent_task: Children read time-themed word and sentence cards.
lessons.assessment_notes: Note phonics application — evidence for ENG.R1.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate reading progress with a themed reading game.
lessons.home_link: Practise reading time words over the week.

lessons.title: Measuring Mass and Capacity Consolidation
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to compare mass and capacity confidently.
success_criteria: I can compare mass using scales.
I can compare capacity using containers.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap mass and capacity from across the year.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Consolidate comparing mass (balance scales) and capacity (containers) with a range of objects.
lessons.independent_task: Children complete mixed mass and capacity comparison activities.
lessons.assessment_notes: End-of-year consolidation check on mass and capacity — evidence for MATHS.MEA.
lessons.home_link: Compare the mass or capacity of two things at home.

lessons.title: Explaining My Timetable
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to explain their daily timetable clearly to the class.
success_criteria: I can explain what happens at each time.
I can answer a question about it.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss what makes a clear explanation of a timetable.
lessons.independent_task: Children explain their daily timetable to a small group, answering a question.
key_questions: Can you answer a question about your timetable?

differentiation.greater_depth: Explain unprompted with confidence and detail

lessons.assessment_notes: Note spoken language and time vocabulary application — evidence for ENG.SL1/MATHS.MEA.
lessons.home_link: Explain your timetable to your family.

lessons.title: Mixed Word Problems: Full Consolidation
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to solve a range of mixed word problems using skills learned across the year.
success_criteria: I can solve an addition problem.
I can solve a subtraction problem.
I can solve a measuring problem.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the year's word problem strategies.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model solving a mixed set of word problems drawing on addition, subtraction, and measurement.
lessons.independent_task: Children solve a mixed set of word problems, choosing appropriate strategies.
key_questions: How will you check your answer?

differentiation.greater_depth: Solve mentally where possible and explain reasoning

lessons.assessment_notes: End-of-year consolidation check on applying number and measurement together — evidence for MATHS.N2/MEA.
lessons.plenary: Recap strategies used across different problem types.
lessons.home_link: Make up a mixed word problem for your family.

lessons.title: Time and Measurement Quiz: Reading Comprehension
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to answer comprehension questions linked to time and measurement.
success_criteria: I can answer a retrieval question.
I can answer an inference question.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the week's time and measurement learning.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Read a summary passage involving time and measurement, modelling retrieval and inference questions.
lessons.independent_task: Children answer a mix of retrieval and inference questions about the passage.
key_questions: What time did the event happen?
Why might a ruler be more accurate than cubes?

differentiation.support: Answer retrieval questions with text pointing

lessons.assessment_notes: Note comprehension progress — evidence for ENG.R2.
lessons.home_link: Quiz your family on time and measurement facts.

lessons.title: Maths Review: Full Time and Measurement Recap
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to apply time and measurement skills learned this week and across the year.
success_criteria: I can tell the time.
I can measure length, mass and capacity.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Quick recap of the week's time and measurement content.
lessons.independent_task: Children complete a mixed review covering time-telling, length, mass and capacity.

differentiation.support: Complete with reduced complexity and support

lessons.assessment_notes: End-of-year time and measurement consolidation summary for each child — evidence for MATHS.MEA.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate the week's time and measurement learning.
lessons.home_link: Review time and measurement together over the weekend.
